context.label: The dragon is named and judged

observations.body: An angel comes with a key and chain. He binds the dragon, who is also called the old serpent, devil, and Satan, and shuts him in the abyss. Thrones and the first resurrection follow. Satan is later released and deceives the nations. Their last gathering ends in fire, and the devil is thrown into the lake of fire.
